name: 莊承義
objective: Helps you to understand the fundamentals of transmission lines and their applications to microwave circuits.
schedule:
Week 1.Introduction
Week 2.Theory of Transmission Lines
Week 3.Theory of Transmission Lines
Week 4.Impedance Matching
Week 5.Impedance Matching
Week 6.Microwave Networks
Week 7.Microwave Networks
Week 8.Power Devider and Coupler
Week 9.Power Devider and Coupler
Week 10.Midterm
Week 11.Microstrip lines
Week 12.Coplanar lines: Coplanar Waveguide (CPW) and Coplanar Strips (CPS)
Week 13.Coplanar lines: Coplanar Waveguide (CPW) and Coplanar Strips (CPS)
Week 14.Introduction to Artificial Transmission Line 
Week 15.Introduction to Artificial Transmission Line 
Week 16.Special Topic on Synthesized Transmission Line 
Week 17.Special Topic on Synthesized Transmission Line 
Week 18. Final Exam
materials:
Textbook: 
1. D. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th Ed., John Wiley & Sons, 2011.
2. K.C. Gupta, R. Garg, I. Bahl, and P. Bhartia, Microstrip Line and Slotlines,   2nd Ed., Artech House, 1997.
3. IEEE Transactions on MTT and AP.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）SDG12：負責任的消費與生產（Responsible Consumption and Production）
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
